description: This file defines the JsonFileCalendarProvider class, which extends AbstractCalendarProvider to manage calendar events stored in JSON files as part of a calendar synchronization system in SuiteCRM. The class provides methods for testing connections, loading, saving, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving events with JSON serialization/deserialization, along with internal mapping between JSON data and domain objects.

classes.name: JsonFileCalendarProvider
classes.description: A provider class that manages calendar events stored as JSON files, supporting CRUD operations, event retrieval, and mapping between JSON data and domain entities in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Tests access to the JSON file, verifies directory writability, loads existing events, and returns connection status.

methods.name: initializeFilePath
methods.description: Sets up the file path for storing calendar data based on connection and user info, creating directory if needed.

methods.name: loadEvents
methods.description: Loads and decodes JSON file content into internal events array, handling errors and empty files.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events matching a query by loading from JSON, filtering, and mapping JSON data to domain objects.

methods.name: mapToCalendarAccountEvent
methods.description: Maps a JSON event data array to a CalendarAccountEvent object, handling missing fields and setting defaults.

methods.name: matchesQuery
methods.description: Checks if an event's start date falls within the query's start and end date range.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event by adding it to the JSON file's event list.

methods.name: generateEventId
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for an event, combining a prefix, a unique ID, and timestamp.

methods.name: mapFromCalendarAccountEvent
methods.description: Converts a CalendarAccountEvent object into an associative array for JSON encoding.

methods.name: saveEvents
methods.description: Encodes current events array into JSON and writes it to the file, handling errors.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event by ID, loading from JSON and mapping to domain object.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event in the JSON file.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Removes an event by ID from the JSON file.
